summary: Well-engineered solution with glob matching and conflict resolution. Workflow follows best practices: pinned action refs (checkout@v4), least-privilege permissions (contents: read, pull-requests: write), sensible triggers. Python script has type hints, custom ConfigError exception, thorough validation. Minor issues: unnecessary `apt-get install python3` on ubuntu-latest (pre-installed); `_glob_to_regex` logic (lines 36-68) is complex and would benefit from inline comments explaining each branch; test fixtures referenced in run_act_tests.py but not provided in deliverable.
